description: Total cost worksheet for one visa route. The government application fee is sourced and dated. Flights, shipping, first rent, adviser, documents and living costs until the first pay are only the person's own figures: pass the ones they know and the rest stay blank, never guessed. Returns the sourced and entered subtotals separately, how many lines are still blank, and a cost-of-living note for the destination.

adviser_usd.description: Immigration adviser or lawyer in US dollars, 0 if none, e.g. 2500.

documents_usd.description: Translation, apostille, police certificates and exams in US dollars, e.g. 700.

flights_usd.description: One-way fares for everyone moving, in US dollars, e.g. 1800.

housing_usd.description: First rent, deposit and agency fees in US dollars, e.g. 6000.

runway_usd.description: Living costs from landing until the first pay cheque in US dollars, e.g. 5000.

shipping_usd.description: Shipping, freight and storage in US dollars, e.g. 4500.

visa_id.description: Transita visa id, e.g. 'ca-cec'. Get ids from transita_match_visas or transita_list_visas.
